assertion_audit.fails_if: the decoded record has different dimensions, flags, stored scalars, or arrays from the captured source; symmetric codec errors can survive
the emitted fixed header, dimensions, flags, scalar formatting, or line count changes
an unsupported trace version is accepted
value, gradient, or Hessian disagrees with SciPy bisplev at the sampled interior points
JAX differentiation, vmap, or Hessian produces a nonfinite value; finite wrong values survive
the synthetic export loses its supplied decision values, header, source grid, psi, or wall; measured export decisions are not checked
a write-read-write cycle changes bytes; a consistent codec error survives
case enumeration drops or duplicates a listed input or omits crossing names; measured decisions are not checked
the named real record no longer triggers a fit or no longer yields a qualified limited-or-diverted decision
the helper accepts a receipt whose own adjacent flag is false or unchanged flag is true; malformed brackets with permissive flags survive
the returned offset differs from the test-supplied 0.1613; the expectation is self-coupled to the supplied receipt and cannot validate other offsets

findings.text: blocking: the case table gives axis positions and spans, but omits the requested per-case boundary levels, absolute and span-relative boundary differences, admitted saddle levels and positions, and wall-contact levels; those data exist only in the JSON and selected prose, so the required disagreement table is incomplete.

blocking: the sweep records five paired sides as unqualified and both synthetic crossing inputs as unread after wall_ring raises on their empty wall arrays; 9 of 28 inputs therefore have no nova boundary decision, leaving the stated all-input cross-check unmet.

blocking: bisected_offset selects only the first bracket's left endpoint and main writes one state per cell count, so the right side of each adjacent-double pair requested at 282 and 550 cells is absent.

blocking: receipt validation trusts adjacent and unchanged booleans without comparing binary64 endpoints or the decision keys; test_export_states.py:77-97 explicitly accepts a zero-width [0.1613, 0.1613] bracket as a bisected state.

blocking: achieved < requested does not establish that receipt requested_cells and achieved_cells match the carrier; pairing the 282-cell receipt with a 550-cell carrier passes this guard and exports an offset bisected for another state.

blocking: the 550-cell receipt's left key is diverted but the delivered 550-cell record reads limited on the export path, so that export is not a demonstrated adjacent-double transition for the read whose decision it carries.
follow-on: TraceSplineField duplicates the not-a-knot JAX value, gradient and Hessian capability in nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:264-325 rather than wrapping or extending the existing owner.

follow-on: the expected offset is the same 0.1613 supplied in _receipt and echoed by the returned entry, so a hard-coded 0.1613 result would pass and the assertion does not protect receipt selection for other offsets.

follow-on: when a trace wall's first and last points differ, wall_units appends the last point again rather than the first; the captured JT-60SA wall has distinct endpoints, so this creates a zero-length terminal edge instead of an explicitly closed unit.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite are prose rather than armed JSON, and no baseline gate log exists; the zero added failures can be inferred from the absent base test path and 12-pass head log but cannot be derived from paired suite logs as requested.
